<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Gogeta''' is the fusion of [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta|Vegeta]] by the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusion Dance|Fusion Dance]], and the champion of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]]. He fights as a Super Saiyan (in game, '''Gogeta (Super Saiyan)''') in the title match, the last bout of the hardest tournament.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Gogeta is the Otherworld Tournament's '''champion'''. After you win your way through the 8-seat bracket of Buu Saga fighters, you face [[Special:MyLanguage/Pikkon|Pikkon]] in the semi-final, [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] (Super Saiyan, with his halo) in the final and Gogeta in the title match. He is one of the three fighters known before you enter, so you can hover him in the bracket view of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments#The tournament screen|tournament screen]] from the start.

<!--T:9-->
By default he has '''1,330,000''' health, '''55,800''' melee damage and '''50,700''' ki damage, and fights on the '''Expert''' AI tier. Unlike the qualifier fighters, he doesn't get stronger with the rounds already played. He doesn't transform, and the bout ends at knockout, so he isn't killed and drops nothing.

<!--T:10-->
Beating Gogeta wins the tournament: '''3,000,000 TP''' and '''+10 alignment''' (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament#Rewards|rewards]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Gogeta flies and moves faster than most saga fighters. On the Expert tier he has the fastest reactions and near-perfect dodging and aim (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).

<!--T:13-->
* '''Ki attacks:''' Ki Volley, Big Bang Attack, Kamehameha and [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Attacks|Soul Punisher]].
* '''Combos:''' Melee Combo, Aerial Combo, Ki Charge Strike and Meteor Combination.
* '''Mobility:''' he backsteps away from your hits, teleports behind you and uses Zanzoken at the highest level (6 after-image hops).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
This Super Saiyan Gogeta doesn't appear in any story quest. The [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest 44, ''Gogeta'', is a fight against a different entity, Gogeta (Super Saiyan 4).
</translate>
